title: Procedural Sedation Workflow

changelog.change: Initial entry — orchestrates ASA class, STOP-BANG, and Modified Aldrete.

purpose: A pre → during → recovery sequence that pulls the relevant risk screens and the discharge score from Calculators.

nodes.body: Informed consent. Baseline vitals. ASA class + STOP-BANG screen (see Calculators) — a high STOP-BANG or ASA ≥ III changes airway readiness and disposition. NPO status: usually not a hard stop for an emergent procedure — document the risk/benefit discussion. Confirm a functioning IV.

Continuous pulse oximetry + capnography + BP cycling. Suction on, oxygen on, bag-valve-mask and airway adjuncts at the bedside. Reversal agents drawn or immediately available: naloxone (opioids), flumazenil (benzodiazepines). A second provider dedicated to monitoring.

Titrate to the target depth (minimal / moderate / deep). Watch the capnography waveform for early hypoventilation before the SpO₂ falls. Treat apnea with stimulation → jaw thrust → BVM; reserve reversal for genuine oversedation, not routine wake-up.

Monitor until the patient returns to baseline. Modified Aldrete ≥ 9 (see Calculators) before discharge. Pain controlled, no active bleeding, tolerating oral intake, back to baseline mentation and ambulation. Written discharge instructions. Require a responsible-adult escort — no driving for the rest of the day.

checklist: Capnography + SpO₂ + BP monitoring in place before the first drug
Suction, O₂, BVM, airway adjuncts, and reversal agents at the bedside
Responsible-adult escort confirmed; written instructions given
